subject: GlobeText trial success plan & model roster — next steps
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@globetext.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 16:00:00 -0800
Subject: GlobeText trial success plan & model roster — next steps

Hi Anna — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned heading into the trial kickoff. I’ve attached the initial PoC requirements workbook you shared and a small sample of the intent dataset you mentioned.

Summary of what we heard on the call
- Primary use: user intent classification and short-form answer generation for customer help articles (EN + ES initially)
- Traffic: ~2k daily messages to start, seasonal spikes up to ~8k/day
- Success criteria you asked for: classification precision/recall targets, response latency SLOs, and a clear rollback plan if quality drops

Proposed success criteria (draft)
- Classification: macro-F1 >= 0.90 on GlobeText labeled dev set (English), >= 0.88 (Spanish)
- Answer quality: ROUGE-L >= 0.60 on curated answers + human spot-checks with >85% pass rate
- Latency: p95 generation latency < 350ms for 512-token budget in Dedicated-like profile; burst capacity handles 99th percentile spikes within 1.5x baseline cost
- Cost target: keep per-1k-token inference cost within the budget you shared (we’ll firm up exact numbers once we see representative token distribution)

Model roster suggestion for trial
- Primary model (accuracy-first): Mistral-Instruct-7B-q4 — strong for instruction-following and lower token cost in quantized mode
- Fallback (robustness / multilingual): Llama-2-13B-chat-q4 — larger but better for difficult edge cases and Spanish coverage
- Safety and guardrails: use output filters + candidate reranking; we’ll surface any hallucination regression in the eval dashboard

Evaluation plan & ownership
- GlobeText provides labeled dev/test sets (EN + ES) and the anonymized production sample (what you sent). Deadline: EOD Feb 19.
- Redwood provides evaluation harness & baseline runs, plus a model comparison report. Owner: Priyom Das (evaluation harness + metrics).
- Serving configuration and latency tuning: Owner: Rishi Malhotra (routing, batching, caching).
- Week 0 kickoff: week of Feb 22. 2-week core trial, with a midpoint sync and final readout the week of Mar 8.

Immediate asks for Anna
1) Confirm the success criteria above (F1 / ROUGE-L / latency target) or suggest edits by Fri, Feb 19.
2) Share the final labeled dev set + any QA rubrics (attach to the Drive link if easier).
3) Confirm preferred start date (we penciled Feb 22).

Attachments: GlobeText-PoC-Requirements.xlsx (your workbook), globetext-prod-intents-sample.zip (anonymized), model-eval-metrics-template.csv (Redwood template)

Thanks — I’ll schedule the kickoff once we have confirmation.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Kimberly / Rishi — I’ll own the evaluation harness and the model comparison report. Notes on technical approach: 

- Ingest the GlobeText dev/test CSVs into the harness; run baseline inference with Mistral-Instruct-7B-q4 and Llama-2-13B-chat-q4. Output: per-intent confusion matrix, macro-F1, precision/recall, response-length histogram, and ROUGE-L for answer tasks.
- Add a reranking step that scores candidates by a combined quality + safety score (simple lexical checks + toxicity filter). This will be in the pipeline so we can show the delta on quality vs raw generation.
- Latency tests: synthetic load runner to measure p95/p99 for 512-token window; test with and without KV cache priming to show real-world behavior. Rishi, I’ll need the serving config you recommend so the harness uses representative batching and concurrency settings.

Timeline (tentative)
- Feb 19: ingest labeled EN set; run first-pass baselines by EOD Feb 23
- Feb 25: mid-trial internal report with key metrics and any glaring regressions
- Mar 8: final trial readout and recommendations

Items I need from GlobeText
- Final dev/test CSV (EN) by Feb 19
- Short list of 20-30 high-priority intents you want prioritized for human review (shared Drive doc)

I’ll draft the eval-run checklist and drop it into the Drive link Kimberly shared.

Cheers,
